body:
_Tips: This project supports both Chinese (zh_cn) and English (en_us)_

丰富原版生存内容

# 附魔介绍

|名称|ID|最大等级|附魔槽位|介绍|
|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-|
|淬毒|`poison`|3|武器|攻击时，给予目标中毒效果|
|凋零|`wither`|3|武器|攻击时，给予目标凋零效果|
|瞬间治疗|`instant_health`|3|武器|攻击时，给予目标瞬间治疗效果|
|爆炸|`explosion`|3|武器|攻击时，生成 `level` 级的爆炸|
|霜冻|`frost`|3|武器|攻击时，给予目标缓慢效果|
|绝境反击|`adversity_counterattack`|3|武器|血量越少，伤害越高|
|名字就是力量|`length_is_power`|1|武器|（BUG）名字越长，伤害越高|
|献祭|`sacrifice`|5|武器|献祭自己 `level` 点血量，给目标造成 `level * 3` 的伤害|
|公平|`fairness`|1|武器|（BUG）攻击时，自己和目标收到相同的伤害|
|嗜血|`bloodthirsty`|3|武器|攻击时，恢复自己 `level` 点血量|

# Mixin 修改

1. 允许在不死图腾上附魔，详见下表。
  
  |名称|效果|
  |:-:|:-|
  |无限|不死图腾不再会消耗掉（因为太强大了，所以把“无限”修改为了宝藏附魔，~~但仍然可以通过交易获得~~）|
  |保护|使用不死图腾后血量基本会恢复至满格|
  |爆炸保护|使用不死图腾后会在原地生成爆炸|
  |引雷|使用不死图腾后会在原地生成雷电|

---

Enrich the original survival content

# Introduction to Enchantments

|Name | ID | Maximum Level | Enchantment Slots | Introduction|
|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-|
|Poison | `poison` | 3 | Weapon | When attacking, give the target a poisoning effect|
|Wither | `wither` | 3 | Weapon | When attacking, give the target a withering effect|
|Instant Health | `instant_health` | 3 | Weapon | Provides instant healing effect to the target during attack|
|Explosion | `explosion` | 3 | Weapon | Generate a `level` explosion during attack|
|Frost | `frost` | 3 | Weapon | When attacking, give the target a slow effect|
|Adversity Counterattack | `adversity_counterattack` | 3 | Weapon | The less health, the higher the damage|
|Name is power | ` length_is_power ` | 1 | Weapon | (BUG) The longer the name, the higher the damage|
|Sacrifice |`sacrifice`|5| Weapon | Sacrifice yourself with `level` health points, dealing `level * 3` damage to the target|
|Fairness | `fairness`|1| Weapon | (BUG) When attacking, both oneself and the target receive the same damage|
|Bloodthirsty | `bloodthirsty` | 3 | Weapon | When attacking, restore your `level` health points|

# Mixin modification
1. Enchantments are allowed on undead totems, as shown in the table below.
  
  |Name | Effect|
  |:-:|:-|
  |Infinite | Undead Totem will no longer be consumed (because it is too powerful, "Infinite" has been modified to treasure enchantment, ~~but it can still be obtained through trading~~)|
  |Protection | After using the Undead Totem, the health will basically recover to full grid|
  |Explosion Protection | Using the Undead Totem will generate an explosion in place|
  |Triggering Thunder | Using the Undead Totem will generate lightning in place|
